title: TD Games Memory Database System
summary: AI-driven corporate memory system for TD Games. Captures Discord/Slack chat logs into a daily summarization pipeline (Digest), uses mem0/Qdrant for semantic storage, and provides specialized bot roles that respond via RAG. Includes intent-based conversational agents for ClickUp task management (with auto-provisioning and platform-aware assignment) and persistent reminders. Proposes a three-layer agent memory model (Session, Markdown-based Workspace, and Long-term Vector) to deepen persona and context persistence.
